//ConnectionStrings: SQLite for Browser V1. A relative Data Source is resolved against the application's content root.
Development sets a path under the repository's git-ignored .data directory.
Staging sets Data Source=/home/data/weapons-of-order.db, on App Service's persistent share and
deliberately outside the deployed application, so a redeployment cannot replace it.
PostgreSQL remains the intended direction for a real production environment; see TECH_STACK.md.
//Database: MigrateOnStartup applies pending EF Core migrations before the first request is served.
Off here on purpose: an environment must ask for it rather than inherit it.
Browser V1 turns it on because there is one instance and one SQLite file on that instance.
A real PostgreSQL production environment must leave it off and migrate from outside the app.
//Hosting: Describes the host this process runs on, not the environment it calls itself.
UseForwardedHeaders belongs on, and only on, a host where a trusted reverse proxy terminates TLS.
Azure App Service sets it through an application setting; see docs/deployment/AZURE_STAGING.md.
Left false here so a process reachable without a proxy never believes a caller's own X-Forwarded-* headers.
//ApplicationInsights: Telemetry is off unless a connection string is present.
App Service supplies APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING; this nested form is for anything else.
The value identifies an Application Insights resource and carries an ingestion key, so it is configuration, never committed.
//Email: None drops messages and records only that it did, which is what a fresh clone gets.
Development ignores this entirely: links are captured in memory and read from /api/dev/account-notifications.
AzureCommunicationServices prefers Endpoint, which authenticates as the host's managed identity and needs no secret.
ConnectionString is an access key and must come from platform configuration, never from this file.

//Password: Length is the only rule: more than five characters, so a minimum of six.
No character-class or diversity requirement - 'aaaaaa' is a valid password.
RequiredUniqueChars is 1 rather than 0 because Identity's default is 1 and one distinct
character is what any non-empty password already has.

//Forge: Temporary prototype balance values for the ordinary forge, not canon.
The blacksmith canon fixes the structure and leaves costs, thresholds and timings as balance data.
Temperature is an abstract 0-100 scale rather than degrees.
StartingMaterials is development bootstrap stock, granted on first use because no economy exists yet.
//Combat: Temporary prototype balance values for the battle prototype, not canon.
The combat canon fixes the structure - one Power stat, the Defense curve's shape, one Energy bar,
a Heavy attack at full Energy, two finite termination guards, 8 active and 16 total - and states
that these numbers are configuration. Unit and weapon combat stats are creator content and live in
server/content, not here.
TickMilliseconds is a prototype implementation detail: canon requires an authoritative combat clock
on which same-timestamp attacks resolve together, and does not say whether it is stepped.
WeightIntervalSeconds is what each weapon weight is worth in Attack Interval; every equipped weapon
contributes its own.
MovementSpeed is the canonical stat, as a multiple of standard movement where higher is faster. The
API translates a Unit's Mounted flag into it; the pure simulator only ever sees the number, and
divides BaseMovementSecondsPerHex by it to get the seconds a hex takes.
Unarmed is what a Unit holding nothing fights with. Canon does not define it; this is the smallest
answer that keeps a battle legal without inventing an unarmed class ability.
TrainingOpponent is a TEMPORARY BATTLE HARNESS, not game content. There is no recruitment, no PvP
and no authored enemy roster yet. Nothing here is in the Unit registry, nothing is persisted, and
the names are neutral placeholders - no kingdom, no faction, no character, no class. It exists only
so the engine can be watched running, and it is replaced whole when a real opponent exists.
Tuned so a fully deployed three-unit starter army with one forged sword wins with something to
spare, and an under-deployed one loses. Deployment is the decision this harness exists to show.
